label: copy-phase input k (fed-back copy of original token k at position >= 2)
explanation: Fires only in the copy phase, at steps where the input is the token k (the model's own previous output fed back), and only when that k was original token index >= 2 (recall_idx >= 3). It never fires on k in the original phase, at the delimiter, or on any other input token (about 13 stray activations on 2/p). Activations at recall_idx 2 (k at original position 1) are rare and weak. Magnitude grows with position in the copy phase: the lowest activations come from k at early positions in short sequences (e.g. t=5-7), and the top activations come from k late in length 8-9 sequences. A repeated k at the next step also fires, at slightly lower magnitude. It does not depend on the output token, the earlier tokens, or the first token.

issues: Main claims hold. Every activation is in the copy phase (original and delimiter phases are 0/3.23M and 0/500k). in_tok k carries 1.000 of the activation mass, with only 13 stray activations on 2 and p. On the test split the predicate scores P 0.990, R 0.990, F1 0.990, mass recall 0.999. Adding correct==1 changes nothing, and the feature never fires when correct==0.

The recall_idx-2 claim is only partly accurate. Overall, recall_idx 2 is rare (test P 0.033 for k at recall_idx 2), but the misses are concentrated in short sequences. When L=3, k at recall_idx 2 fires 49% of the time (444 predicted); at L=4 it fires 13%; at L>=5 it fires 0%. Almost all of the 567 test misses come from this cell, but they hold only 0.1% of the activation mass. Folding in (recall_idx==2)&(L==3) would add about as many false positives as true positives, so F1 would not improve.

The false positives (564 on test) are almost all at recall_idx==3 (precision 0.965 there, against 1.000 for recall_idx>=4). Precision there dips for L=6-8 (0.93-0.97) and is a little lower when k repeats in the original (in_count>=2: 0.91) or when k is also orig(0) or orig(1) (0.83-0.86). These are mild modulations at the onset boundary, not a separate class of counterexamples.

The label matches the predicate and does not overclaim. Magnitude growing with position is consistent with the profile: rate is flat at about 3.3% from recall_idx 3 onward, while mass share and t-dependence rise later.
